		Date as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> SRCFFLOADFALLOUT

		ERROR_MESSAGE as string,
		FALLOUT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ERROR_MESSAGE = Error_Message,
		FALLOUT_DATE = Date,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> DSTOLEDBLOADFALLOUT
